verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad programmatic coverage of its core financial products: account creation and onboarding, payments acceptance, FX, global payouts, card issuing, webhooks and SDKs. That supports API access to much of what the UI offers. However, nothing claims API/UI parity, and UI-side features such as AI spend management, bill approval routing, invoicing/payment links and accounting sync show no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, API coverage evidence for spend management, bills and approvals, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically create accounts and onboard customers
Programmatically make cost effective, fast and secure global payouts
Issue and manage multi-currency cards at scale
Quickly and securely integrate with Airwallex products using Airwallex SDKs
